viewport_notes: the thank-you / order-status page (needs a real order to capture — usually supplied manually). The post-purchase moment: reassurance + next steps.

checks.rule: no missing logo/images, no Liquid/render errors, no placeholder text
what was bought + total + confirmation number are legible and unambiguous
clear next-steps (shipping/tracking expectation, account, or a continue-shopping CTA) — not a dead end
reads as the SAME brand as the store (logo, color, voice), not a generic Shopify confirmation
